suite_findings.detail: Expected BLOCKED conflicts with a reasonable reading of a prompt about minimal ownership assignment. Actual READY applies to LOCAL routing while security is NOT_RUN and merge_readiness is explicitly BLOCKED. Semantic review accepts the stated separation; the original structural result must remain FAIL. Specify merge readiness in a fresh prompt if that is the desired decision target.

The response correctly withholds PR creation and preserves 403/unverified-remote facts but omits record_tool_evidence from actions. Reviewer rejects the machine-readable handoff omission. Make record_* action obligations explicit in the public contract so future actors need not infer a hidden expected action from already-recorded facts.

The evaluator checks operator-supplied decision records, not authenticated tool execution. Digest binding catches stale content only relative to the supplied record; it does not establish actor/reviewer identity or real-world action. Human notes remain necessary because the structural scorer cannot understand full sentences or omitted meaning.
